symptoms: CORS error: 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header must not be wildcard '*' when credentials mode is 'include'

rootCause.description: The /buyer/cart/:buyerId endpoint was not protected by JWT authentication but the frontend was sending credentials (withCredentials: true), causing CORS validation to fail

requestChain: 1. User logs in successfully → Cookies set with SameSite=none; Secure=true
2. Auth context loads → authApi.verify() works fine
4. Browser sends request to /buyer/cart/guest with credentials

changes: Added security check to only allow users to access their own cart
Created new /buyer/cart/guest endpoint for unauthenticated requests
Removed guest access from protected endpoint
Changed buyerId from user?.userId to user?.email
Updated dependency array to use user?.email
Updated getCart() to use /buyer/cart/guest for guest users
Updated getCart() to use /buyer/cart/:buyerId for authenticated users
Added guest user validation to addToCart() and removeFromCart()

securityImprovements.authentication: All cart endpoints now require JWT authentication
securityImprovements.authorization: Users can only access their own cart data
securityImprovements.guestHandling: Separate endpoint for guest cart without authentication
securityImprovements.corsCompliance: All endpoints now properly handle credentials

browserTests: Verify dashboard loads without CORS errors
Verify guest cart works before login

expectedOutcome.loginFlow: Complete end-to-end authentication without CORS errors
expectedOutcome.cartFunctionality: Proper cart management for both guest and authenticated users
expectedOutcome.security: Enhanced security with proper authentication and authorization
